# Pop faction types — synthetic fixture for testing

faction_egalitarian = {
	name = egalitarian
	election_header = GFX_faction_header_egalitarian
	guiding_ethic = ethic_egalitarian
	use_guiding_ethic_as_faction_ethic = yes
	unique = no

	can_join_faction = {
		is_enslaved = no
		is_being_purged = no
	}

	attraction = {
		base = 1
		modifier = {
			factor = 10
			has_ethic = ethic_egalitarian
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 10
			has_ethic = ethic_fanatic_egalitarian
		}
	}

	issues = {
		political_issue = {
			option = migration_controls_allowed
			title = political_issue_egalitarian_migration
			effect = { faction_approval = 10 }
		}
		political_issue = {
			option = slavery_banned
			title = political_issue_egalitarian_slavery
			effect = { faction_approval = 10 }
		}
	}

	demand = {
		name = egalitarian_demand_democracy
		unfulfilled_effect = -5
		fulfilled_effect = 10
		trigger = {
			exists = owner
			owner = {
				OR = {
					has_authority = auth_democratic
					has_authority = auth_direct_democratic
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

faction_militarist = {
	name = militarist
	election_header = GFX_faction_header_militarist
	guiding_ethic = ethic_militarist
	use_guiding_ethic_as_faction_ethic = yes
	unique = no

	can_join_faction = {
		is_enslaved = no
		is_being_purged = no
	}

	attraction = {
		base = 1
		modifier = {
			factor = 10
			has_ethic = ethic_militarist
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 10
			has_ethic = ethic_fanatic_militarist
		}
	}

	issues = {
		political_issue = {
			option = interference_interference
			title = political_issue_militarist_interference
			effect = { faction_approval = 10 }
		}
	}

	demand = {
		name = militarist_demand_fleet
		unfulfilled_effect = -10
		fulfilled_effect = 5
		trigger = {
			exists = owner
			owner = {
				has_ethic = ethic_militarist
			}
		}
	}
}

faction_xenophile = {
	name = xenophile
	election_header = GFX_faction_header_xenophile
	guiding_ethic = ethic_xenophile
	use_guiding_ethic_as_faction_ethic = yes
	unique = no

	can_join_faction = {
		is_enslaved = no
		is_being_purged = no
	}

	attraction = {
		base = 1
		modifier = {
			factor = 10
			has_ethic = ethic_xenophile
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 10
			has_ethic = ethic_fanatic_xenophile
		}
	}

	issues = {
		political_issue = {
			option = migration_controls_allowed
			title = political_issue_xenophile_migration
			effect = { faction_approval = 10 }
		}
	}

	demand = {
		name = xenophile_demand_open_borders
		unfulfilled_effect = -5
		fulfilled_effect = 10
		trigger = {
			exists = owner
			owner = {
				has_policy_flag = migration_controls_allowed
			}
		}
	}
}
